content.short: Orange Protocol aggregates reputation data to create and mint reputation proofs as Verifiable Credentials and NFTs.
content.description: Orange Protocol aggregates a range of Web3 reputation models and supplementary data to generate reputation proofs that are minted as Verifiable Credentials and NFTs. By considering a broad set of data points and examining an individual's behavior and preferences, it seeks to objectively calculate and present the reputation of a wallet address owner. The resulting reputation proofs encapsulate verifiable signals tied to that address, supporting consistent evaluation across interactions and ecosystems in a decentralized environment.
